$comment: Human catalog metadata for design languages. Merged with brands/*/brand.json by scripts/sync-languages.mjs → languages.json (AUTO-GENERATED).
description: Design-language catalog for global product chrome swap (Create Center / SaaS theme). Not color moods — full Brand Packages (roles + recipe + elev + zones).

factory.name: Nebutra Factory
factory.description: Default product chrome from @nebutra/tokens (no skin). Clear data-brand to restore.

linear.description: Dual-mode: dark void default + light paper; solid acid-lime CTA, compact density.

gsap.description: Dark cream-on-void; shockingly-green is accent — CTA is gradient-stroke/outline, not solid green fill.

raycast.description: Neutral Mist/Iron filled CTA; Coral is brand-mark only. Key elevation stack.

vercel.description: Monochrome dual-mode: light paper + Obsidian CTA; dark carbon + white CTA; hairline elevation (no chromatic CTA).

vanta.description: Editorial violet on parchment; Vivid Violet action ≠ Indigo Ink brand-mark; full pills; elevation=none (carbon hairlines).

stripe.description: Indigo-ink ledger on frost glass; Indigo action ≠ Midnight brand-mark; 4px controls; elevation=none (tint + frost rules).

notion.description: Warm paper notebook; Notion Blue sole filled CTA ≠ Ink brand-mark; 8px buttons / 12px cards; elev=none + hairline; accent hues decorative only.
proves: elevation=none content cards + raised nav shadow slot
